findings.citationQuote: ISO 22716:2007 (Cosmetics GMP) — Certificate No. IN-COS-22716-0499, issued 2023-04-18, valid until 2026-04-17.

Per instructions, the expiry date is reported exactly as written without judging currency.

No section of the supplier document mentions minimum order quantity (MOQ) or any first-order unit threshold. The document covers certifications, manufacturing capability, quality history, sustainability, and cost reference, but no MOQ figure is stated anywhere.
The Quality history section reports 6 of 30 audited production batches failed, stated explicitly as 20%. This is the historical quality inspection fail rate figure reported in the document.
No section of the supplier document states a manufacturing lead time in days or any turnaround/production timeframe. This aspect is not addressed anywhere in the provided document.
The title block states the supplier's location as Hyderabad, Telangana, India, which is reported verbatim as the categorical value without a pass/fail determination.
